name: Trace Practice
summary: A technical case identity built around inspectable before-and-after work, explicit boundaries and an authored trace register.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style Title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style TableBody.

recognitionRules: Use numbered sections to move from decision to inputs, comparison and complete trace.
Pair IBM Plex Sans explanations with mono labels for prompts, IDs and limits.
Keep the proposed output beside the baseline, giving qualifications equal prominence.
Use pale mint reading areas and gold as a bounded emphasis, never a success signal.

principles: Move from observation to interpretation to a bounded next question.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Show the instruction, the change and the limit that survived.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid “proves” when the material only supports a hypothesis.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: A record suggests a direction; it does not speak for every person.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use TRACE PRACTICE in IBM Plex Sans with a small monospaced trace number aligned to the baseline. An open bracket is supporting punctuation, not a certification badge.
invariants: Use numbered sections to move from decision to inputs, comparison and complete trace.
Pair IBM Plex Sans explanations with mono labels for prompts, IDs and limits.
Keep the proposed output beside the baseline, giving qualifications equal prominence.
adaptations: For a short case, keep one comparison and its full qualification.
Expand the register independently of the opening narrative.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
